mainText: Shevchenko lying about drugs test claims - Mudryk. Mykhailo Mudryk accuses Ukraine legend Andriy Shevchenko of lying about the circumstances surrounding the winger's positive drugs test as his dispute with the country's football federation continues. Osimhen keen on Man Utd move - Saturday's gossip. Victor Osimhen is keen on a move to Manchester United, Aston Villa are interested in Amad Diallo and Ivan Toney is a target for Crystal Palace, plus more. NFL great Brady could buy Chelsea stake. American football great Tom Brady is looking to invest in Chelsea through ownership group Clearlake Capital.

mainText: Zelensky says Crimean Bridge strikes 'fair response' as he meets UK's Streeting. Ukraine's president says Kyiv acted after 109 separate Russian aerial attacks on bridges in Ukraine. Catherine talks openly about how cancer changed her in documentary on BBC. "There is a much, much deeper part to what a cancer diagnosis shifts in you," says Catherine in the documentary. 'We're not meant to carry life's challenges alone', Catherine says in first clip. Catherine has spoken about how "cancer does change you" in a documentary that will be screened on BBC One on 29 November. Deal with EU not dependent on tuition fees agreement, Miliband says. Brussels sources had previously suggested the bloc might not apply the wider deal until fees were lowered for EU students in Britain.
